scripts.lint: python -m ruff check apps/orchestrator/src apps/orchestrator/tests tests scripts && npm run lint:web
scripts.test: python -m pytest -m "not integration and not docker and not live_provider and not live_github" -q && npm run test:web -- --run
scripts.test:integration: python -m pytest -m "integration and not live_provider and not live_github" -q
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && python -m pytest -m "not live_provider and not live_github" -q && npm run test:web -- --run && npm run build
